args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when
parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade within the 2.x line to 2.9.4,
the fixed version.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Context
CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affects fastjson <2.9.4 (2.x line). Version 2.9.4 contains the fix, so this is a patch/minor upgrade within the same major version.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.
